notes.title: Patch v 1.0.2
notes.notes: Small balance tweaks and fixed Block Bust bug.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v 1.0.1 3/28/24
notes.notes:
This patch includes:

- Improvement to shield. The shield will now place the ball in front of the player so that the player cannot bounce the ball back into the abyss.

- Improved difficulty. The difficulty is more manageable now so that longer games and higher scores are possible. (will continue to balance)
